note: Hand-entered values of the Magellanic gas system. Each has evidence { source, quote }: the quote is copied from the fetched page of that source and checked by features/magellanic.mjs (checkQuote). Source ids are defined in that file.

pole_l.what: Galactic longitude of the pole of the Magellanic Stream great circle

evidence.quote: The pole of this great circle is at ( l , b ) = ( 188.5 ∘ , − 7.5 ∘ )

pole_b.what: Galactic latitude of the pole of the Magellanic Stream great circle

evidence.quote: The pole of this great circle is at ( l , b ) = ( 188.5 ∘ , − 7.5 ∘ )

zero_l.what: Galactic longitude of the LMC centre, which defines L_MS = 0

evidence.quote: the center of the LMC ( l , b = 280.47 ∘ , − 32.75 ∘ : van der Marel et al. 2002) has L MS = 0 ∘

zero_b.what: Galactic latitude of the LMC centre, which defines L_MS = 0

evidence.quote: the center of the LMC ( l , b = 280.47 ∘ , − 32.75 ∘ : van der Marel et al. 2002) has L MS = 0 ∘

sense.what: Direction of increasing longitude in the Magellanic Stream system

evidence.quote: L MS decreases along the MS (towards its tail)

ms_tip_lmin.what: MS longitude of the far end of the Stream tip

evidence.quote: approximate distance for the MS-tip ( − 140° ≲ L MS ≲ − 100°)

ms_tip_distance.what: Approximate distance adopted for the Stream tip

evidence.quote: we pick a value of 120 kpc as an approximate distance for the MS-tip

ms_distance.what: Average distance assumed to the Stream when dating it

evidence.quote: as well as an average distance of 50 kpc to the Stream

ms_length.what: Length of the Magellanic Stream (at least)

evidence.quote: and that the MS is at least ∼ 140 ∘ long

system_length.what: Length of the whole Stream plus Leading Arm system (at least)

evidence.quote: the entire MS and Leading Arm (LA) system is thus at least 200 ∘ long

ms_mass_bruns.what: H I mass of the classical Stream (Bruns et al. 2005, quoted by Nidever et al. 2010)

ms_mass_putman.what: H I mass of the Stream for an assumed distance of 55 kpc (Putman et al. 2003)

evidence.quote: raises our estimate for the mass of the Stream to 2.1 × 10 8 M ⊙

ms_discovery.what: Discovery of the H I tail named the Magellanic Stream

evidence.quote: named the Magellanic Stream ( Wannier & Wrixon 1972 ; Mathewson et al. 1974

bridge_distance.what: Distance adopted for the Magellanic Bridge

evidence.quote: we use distances to the LMC, Bridge and SMC of 50, 55 and 60 kpc, respectively

bridge_mass.what: H I mass of the Magellanic Bridge for an assumed distance of 55 kpc

evidence.quote: Bridge and Stream assumed to be at 55 kpc. 5.5 × 10 7

bridge_discovery.what: First report of the Bridge in H I observations

evidence.quote: The Magellanic Bridge was first reported in H I observations by Hindman et al. 1963

la1_box.what: Extent of the Leading Arm complex LA I in MS coordinates

la2_box.what: Extent of the Leading Arm complex LA II in MS coordinates

la_mass.what: H I mass of the Leading Arm at b < 0 deg (Putman et al. 1998, quoted by Putman et al. 2003)

evidence.quote: has a mass of around 10% that of the Stream or ∼ 2 × 10 7 M ⊙

la_distance.what: Distance assumed for the Leading Arm

evidence.quote: Assuming a 50 kpc distance of the LA

la_discovery.what: Discovery of the gaseous Leading Arm with HIPASS

evidence.quote: Putman et al. 1998 used the HIPASS data ( Barnes et al. 2001 ) to discover a gaseous leading arm of the MS
